decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.
Reason: In order to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended by Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: [insert plan numbers/documents].
Reason: In order to ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.
Condition : 3 - The number of car parking spaces hereby approved shall not exceed 70, including 50 standard parking spaces, 16 EVC spaces and 4 accessible spaces at all times. 
Reason: In order to support sustainable transport objectives.
Condition : 4 - Within three months after the approval of this application, the car park shall be marked out on the ground as 50 standard parking spaces, 16 EVC spaces and 4 accessible spaces in accordance with drawing number F24049/02-A. The arrangement shall be maintained at all times thereafter.
Reason: In order to prevent obstruction and inconvenience to users of the adjacent highway and the premises, and in the interests of road safety. 
Condition : 5 - The car park is strictly for the use of the existing businesses established on the site and the International School of London. The car park is not to be managed or used on a commercial basis or sub-let to other users. 
Reason: In order to ensure the use of the car park is lawful and in the interests of road safety.
Condition : 6 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the Car Park Management Plan Version Final (V6) dated November 2026 approved by the Local Planning Authority. 
Reason: To ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.
Condition : 7 - No development above ground level shall take place until full details of the Electric Vehicle Charging Points, each capable of  a minimum output of 7.2kW, are submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The details shall include manufacturer's specifications and the number of spaces provided with active and passive capabilities shall comply with the London Plan standards.
The charging points shall be installed in accordance with the approved details, with photographic evidence submitted to the Local Planning Authority upon completion, and so maintained at all times thereafter.
Reason: In order to promote sustainable modes of transport.
Condition : 8 - Within three months after the approval of this application, full details (including manufacturer's specifications) of 20 secure covered cycle stands shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The facilities shall conform to the current Westtrans West London Cycle Parking Guidance (or such other guidance as shall supersede it).
The approved facilities shall be fully implemented and thereafter retained for use at all times without obstruction.
Reason: In order to support sustainable transport objectives.
Condition : 9 - The landscaping details shown on the submitted plans and documents shall be carried out as approved. 
The works shall comply with the requirements specified in BS 3936 (1992) 'Specification of Nursery Stock Part 1 Trees and Shrubs', and in BS 4428 (1989) 'Recommendations for General Landscape Operations'.
All landscaping comprised in the approved details shall be carried out during the first planting and seeding seasons following completion of construction works or first occupation. Any trees or shrubs planted (including any such replacements) which die within five years from the date of planting shall be replaced in the next planting season with the same species, and of comparable maturity. The development shall be maintained in accordance with the approval.
Reason: In order to ensure a satisfactory appearance of the site and the area.
subdivision_of_building: The Application relates to a car park not a building.
description: Retrospective permission for the formation of the northern car park.
